name: Augment Code
tagline: Code review agent in the Cosmos platform: risk-triaged inline PR comments with full-codebase context; GitHub-native, others via CLI.
pricing: Business $100/mo flat (up to 50 seats) incl. $100/mo pooled usage, plus flat 40% fee on LLM usage; Enterprise custom. Code review on all plans
selfHostedNote: No self-hosted offering documented; Enterprise cites custom compute and multi-region deployment in Augment's cloud.
modelControl: Choose from a vendor model list (Claude, GPT-5.x, Gemini families); no BYOK

01-multi-dimensional-context.note: Context Engine reads the full codebase; cross-repo context via external repos declared in AGENTS.md.

02-rule-centric.note: YAML review guidelines with globs and severities; docs commit to high signal-to-noise and no style nags.

03-dual-workflow.note: GitHub PR reviews plus Auggie CLI/CI automation; no distinct local pre-commit review mode documented.

04-business-logic.note: Jira Cloud and Linear integrations plus MCP tools; ticket-vs-code validation not explicitly documented.

05-continuous-learning.note: Code Review Memory captures reviewer feedback and distills per-repo knowledge shared across agents.

06-sandbox-validation.note: Cosmos Verifier agent exercises changes in a running environment and reports evidence-backed findings.

07-economic-transparency.note: No BYOK; model choice from a vendor list; discloses a flat 40% fee on LLM usage with a credit dashboard.

08-actionability.note: 'Fix in Augment' hands findings to an agent session in IDE/CLI; no one-click commit from the PR.

09-measurable-roi.note: Dashboard: PRs reviewed, % comments addressed, thumbs-up rate, estimated dev hours saved; no DORA metrics.
